page_title: DOR 1-0 WER | Dortmund v Werder Bremen 20/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Felix Brych didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
90+2' Foul! Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Edin Terzic has decided to make a change. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) replaces Julian Brandt.
88' Werder Bremen are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
87' Substitution. Anthony Jung leaves the pitch and is replaced by Rafael Borre (Werder Bremen).
85' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
85' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
85' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
83' The whistle blows and Milos Veljkovic (Werder Bremen) is booked for an infringement.

83' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

82' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Gregor Kobel guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) is replacing Romano Schmid.
81' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
81' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
78' Shots on target – 5:0.
77' Edin Terzic decides to make a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug will be replaced by Sebastien Haller (Dortmund).
76' Donyell Malen goes off the pitch and Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) comes on.
75' The attendance for today's match is 80000.
75' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Brych had an easy-decision to make.

71' Werder Bremen slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
68' It will be a substitution. Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Leonardo Bittencourt walks off.
68' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Dawid Kownacki is replaced by Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
67' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) was set free in the area by Emre Can and fired past Michael Zetterer. 1:0.
67' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
64' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Dortmund for a penalty. Play continues.

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
62' Here is a change. Marco Reus is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marius Wolf as he is replaced by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
61' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Felix Brych and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
60' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
58' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) swings in a cross from the corner, but Michael Zetterer reads it well and gathers the ball.

58' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Marco Reus (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
57' Marco Reus (Dortmund) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
57' It looks like Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) saw red with that tackle. Felix Brych won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
55' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

54' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
53' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) comes to nothing.
53' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Dortmund force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
52' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
50' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
48' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
47' Dortmund are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Felix Brych blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Michael Zetterer is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) for his blatant foul.
43' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
42' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

40' Michael Zetterer was forced into action to thwart Donyell Malen (Dortmund). He found himself some space after picking up a pass and unleashed a strike to the top left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.

38' Dortmund slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
37' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
36' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

36' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
35' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
34' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
32' Marco Reus (Dortmund) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
31' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
30' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Donyell Malen (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Dortmund will take a corner.
27' Wonderful movement by Dortmund. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
26' One of the Dortmund players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
26' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes it short.
26' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Dortmund win a corner.
24' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

24' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Michael Zetterer has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and Dortmund manage to earn a corner.

23' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Dortmund are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
20' The referee blows his whistle as Emre Can (Dortmund) was too aggressive in his challenge.

19' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball has crossed the sideline. Dortmund are taking a throw-in.
18' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
17' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

17' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
15' The resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
15' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Werder Bremen earn a corner.
14' A dangerous towering header by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
13' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
13' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Marco Reus (Dortmund) misdirects his free kick from outside the box and the ball sails well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
12' A dangerous free kick that is situated just outside the box will be taken by Marco Reus (Dortmund) who is well-known for his brilliant shooting technique.

11' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Brych with no other option than to blow for a foul.
11' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
10' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

10' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Dortmund.
9' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
7' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post.
7' There's an opportunity for Julian Brandt (Dortmund) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

6' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.

6' A sweet pass finds Donyell Malen (Dortmund) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Michael Zetterer is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
5' Marco Reus (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
4' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
2' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
